logline: Yamal and Raphinha laugh at Real 0-1 PSV; after each of Real's five goals the scorer sneaks in and slaps them — and when they laugh at the LaLiga table, all five return in the dark.

beats.idea: Barça dressing room: Yamal + Raphinha laugh at Real 0-1 PSV on the TV
50' Valverde 1-1: sneaks in behind, slaps Raphinha; Yamal keeps laughing at him
64' Mbappé 3-1: Yamal acts cool — 'Wake up!' slap (callback to Ep41)
84' Mbappé 4-1: they hide behind cushions; Mbappé slaps the cushions away
87' Vinícius 5-1: samba slaps to the beat
full time 5-1, ice packs; remote → LaLiga table Barça 36 · Real 33; they start laughing again
five shadows rise behind them, lights out, five slaps in the dark; question + follow card

twist: they think the LaLiga table saves them — the five scorers are already standing behind them
callback: 'Wake up!' reverses Ep41 (Yamal slapped Mbappé); the laughing from the opening returns right before the final blackout
hidden_details: red cheeks get redder with every slap
the TV shows the real scorer and minute after each goal
five pairs of eyes in the dark = the five goals
meme_frame: Valverde slapping laughing Raphinha while Yamal still laughs
novelty_override: lead yamal and the TV-watching set were the owner's explicit request (25 Nov)
